title: Filipino-Style Egg Bake
description: A rich and savory egg dish inspired by Filipino cuisine, perfect for breakfast or brunch.
instructions: In a large skillet, cook the sliced sausage over medium heat until browned.
Add the diced bell peppers to the skillet and cook until tender.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs and Filipino-style seasoning blend.
Pour the egg mixture over the cooked sausage and bell peppers in the skillet.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the eggs are set.
Remove the skillet from the oven and top with shredded cheddar cheese.
Return the skillet to the oven and bake for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the skillet from the oven and slice into serving portions.
